verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a single integration (Hosted Payment Page / Drop-in Element / Payment Links) that adapts fields per payment method/country and mentions 160+ local payment methods via invoicing, plus multi-currency pricing to unlock local methods, but no explicit evidence naming Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL support. Missing for 10: explicit listing/documentation of specific wallets (Apple Pay/Google Pay) and BNPL providers, and independent confirmation these render correctly in a single checkout integration.
